description: ALGEBRAIC correction to proton mass: m_p = m_p(FamilyA) x (q+1)^2 sqrt(3+h^2)/8. Closes the 2.89% gap to 0.037% (78x improvement). Derived from the B_3 spectral phase on V_{(2,1)}: chi = 2-3h^4-h^6 (exact), theta = arccos(chi/2), theta/(8*hbar^2) = (q+1)^2*sqrt(3+h^2)/8 at leading order (0.024% accurate). Every factor is algebraic in q_0. No fitting.

derivation_chain: theta = arccos(chi/2) [spectral phase of unitary B_3 operator]
m_p = m_p(FamilyA) x correction [algebraic in q_0, no fitting]

precision_ladder.series: θ = √(2x) × Σ c_n x^n where x = h⁴(3+h²)/2, c_n = C(2n,n)/(4^n(2n+1))
precision_ladder.plateau: m_p plateaus at 0.013% (122 ppm) — residual is from lw_A, not h-series
